berry-sweet.name: Berry Sweet
berry-sweet.flavor_text: A berry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

black-flute.name: Black Flute
black-flute.short_desc: Halves the wild Pokemon encounter rate.
black-flute.desc: Used outside of battle : Decreases the wild Pokemon encounter rate by 50%.
black-flute.flavor_text: A flute made from black glass. It makes it easier to encounter strong Pokemon in the place you use it.

chipped-pot.name: Chipped Pot
chipped-pot.flavor_text: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokemon evolve. It may be chipped, but tea poured from it is delicious.

clover-sweet.name: Clover Sweet
clover-sweet.flavor_text: A clover-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

cracked-pot.name: Cracked Pot
cracked-pot.flavor_text: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokemon evolve. It may be cracked, but tea poured from it is delicious.

dawn-stone.flavor_text: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokemon evolve. It sparkles like a glittering eye.

dragon-scale.desc: Held by Seadra: Evolves the holder into Kingdra when traded.
dragon-scale.flavor_text: A very tough and inflexible scale. Dragon-type Pokemon may be holding this item when caught.

dubious-disc.name: Dubious Disc
dubious-disc.short_desc: Traded on a Porygon2: Holder evolves into Porygon-Z.
dubious-disc.desc: Held by Porygon2: Evolves the holder into Porygon-Z when traded.
dubious-disc.flavor_text: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.

lure.name: Lure
